main_body: Flat-roofed sandstone building: a sand-coloured terrace roof with a parapet and a teal dome on top (rows 3-33), above a brick front wall with an arched door and a lattice window (rows 35-64).
top_band: At x=32 the column runs: dark outline at row 2, then a light parapet rim (rows 3-5), then sand terrace (L~190-214, rows 23-33) with the teal dome and its pale base standing on it (rows 7-22). A lighter front-edge line sits at rows 30-33, and the brick front face starts at row 35.
evidence: The roof is a large horizontal sand surface with speckle texture, a parapet and a dome, and it reads as seen from above. A light front-edge line (rows 30-33) separates it from a dark eave shadow (rows 34-36, L~78-108) and the brick face below. The front face has its own brick shading, an arched door with a pale frame and a window with a sill. The recess cues are modest, but both a top and a front face are clearly drawn, so it passes. The top is tall compared with the front face, but a flat roof terrace plausibly reads that way.

style.evidence: Outlines are tinted dark brown, with 0% neutral dark edge pixels. The materials carry several steps: sand has about 4 tones with speckle, brick about 4 with per-brick variation, and the teal dome about 4-5 with highlight facets. Flat-fill coverage is only 2%. Density is below the references (median 8 colours per tile against 11 and 18; 30 distinct colours against 66 and 185), but it is close to the stone house, and the textures, tinted outlines and lack of flat fills keep it acceptable next to the references.
